nodes.name: Chemical reduction and annealing
nodes.procedure: Mo-NiO/Ni (MNN) nanocomposites were synthesized by chemical reduction followed by annealing in N2 atmosphere with different Mo/(Mo+Ni) ratios of 4%, 8%, 16%, and 20% at the precursor stage, denoted as MNN-1, MNN-2, MNN-3, and MNN-4 respectively.
nodes.source_text: Mo-NiO/Ni (MNN) nanocomposites were synthesized by chemical reduction and annealing in the N2 atmosphere.

nodes.name: Reference sample synthesis
nodes.procedure: Three reference samples were also synthesized: Ni nanoparticles (NPs), c-Mo-NiO, and c-Mo-NiO/Ni (where 'c' represents that NiO is crystalline in nanocomposites).
nodes.source_text: In addition, three reference samples were also synthesized: Ni nanoparticles (NPs), c-Mo-NiO, and c-Mo-NiO/Ni

nodes.description: HER performance in 1 M KOH on GCE
nodes.source_text: The η10 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3, and 4) are 118, 76, 50, and 352 mV, respectively (Figure 5A). The Tafel slopes derived from polarization curves (Figure 5B) are 153, 110, 86, and 170 mV dec-1 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4), respectively. The electron-transfer resistances (Rct) for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 ) are 12.5, 8.95, and 5.95 Ω, respectively. The Cdl for MNN-4 is only 0.18 mF cm-2, while the other samples show much higher Cdl of 23.32, 43.20, and 43.84 mF cm-2, for MNN-x with x = 1, 2, 3, respectively (Figure S14).

nodes.description: HER performance in 1 M KOH on GCE
nodes.source_text: The η10 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3, and 4) are 118, 76, 50, and 352 mV, respectively (Figure 5A). The Tafel slopes derived from polarization curves (Figure 5B) are 153, 110, 86, and 170 mV dec-1 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4), respectively. The chronopotentiometry curve of MNN-3 shows good stability toward HER (Figure 5D), with no obvious decay in η over the course of the test (inset in Figure 5D). The geometric exchange current density (j0,geometric) for MNN-3 is 2.59 mA cm-2 (Figure S13).

nodes.description: HER performance in 1 M KOH on GCE
nodes.source_text: The η10 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3, and 4) are 118, 76, 50, and 352 mV, respectively (Figure 5A). The Tafel slopes derived from polarization curves (Figure 5B) are 153, 110, 86, and 170 mV dec-1 for MNN-x (x = 1, 2, 3 and 4), respectively. The Rct for MNN-4 is 372.9 Ω, nearly 2 orders of magnitude greater than the other samples. The Cdl for MNN-4 is only 0.18 mF cm-2.

nodes.description: Anodic oxidation optimization of Ni NPs for HER in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: an anodic oxidation process was performed in a potential window of 1.0 - 1.6 V vs RHE. Using this procedure, the η10 for Ni NPs will be optimized from 198 to 145 mV

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show MNN samples consist of agglomerated nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images (Figure S3) show that the samples consist of agglomerated NPs...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals MNN nanoparticle sizes ~40-100 nm; Ni crystalline region decreases and amorphous Mo-NiO layer thickens from MNN-1 to MNN-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images (Figure S4) show that the size of the NPs are ∼40−100 nm. The TEM images also reveal that from MNN-1 to MNN-4... the Ni region gradually becomes smaller while the amorphous layer becomes thicker...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of MNN-x show peaks at 44.5°, 51.8°, and 76.4° corresponding to (111), (200), and (220) planes of fcc Ni; additional peaks at 37.2° and 62.9° for (111) and (220) of rock-salt NiO only in MNN-4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the MNN-x samples (Figures 2B and S5) show three peaks located at 44.5, 51.8, and 76.4°, which correspond to the (111), (200), and (220) planes of fcc Ni...

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern of MNN-3 shows one set of diffraction rings attributed to (111), (200), (220), (311), and (331) planes of fcc Ni, indicating polycrystalline Ni.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Only one set of diffraction rings can be observed in a selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern of MNN-3 (Figure 2C), which are attributed to the (111), (200), (220), (311), and (331) planes of fcc Ni...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows Mo-NiO/Ni structure with crystalline Ni (111) planes and amorphous Mo-NiO region; FFT confirms crystallinity in Ni region but not in Mo-NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images of the Mo-NiO/Ni structure are shown from a side view in Figure 3B... No bright spot is observed in the Mo-NiO region, indicating its amorphous nature.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and EDS mapping show Mo concentrated in the outer amorphous layer of particles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To further determine the relative distributions of Ni and Mo in the nanocomposite, high-angle annular dark field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) was conducted, and the energy dispersive Xray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping results are shown in Figure 3E.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping of MNN-3 confirms homogeneous distribution of Ni, Mo, and O elements with Mo enriched in outer amorphous layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS elemental mapping of MNN-3 shows the presence of Ni, Mo, and O (Figure S7), indicating the coexistence of Ni and Mo-NiO in this sample... Mo is more concentrated in the outer amorphous layer of the particles...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p XPS shows Ni0 at 852.5 eV and Ni2+ at 855.8 eV; Ni0 percentage decreases from 35.7% to 10.6% with increasing Mo; Mo 3d shows Mo4+ (229.2 eV), Mo5+ (230.4 eV), Mo6+ (232.2 eV) with average valence increasing from 5.18 to 5.58; O 1s shows strong defect oxygen peak at 531.4 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectra (XPS)... The peaks located at 852.5 and 855.8 eV were assigned to Ni0 and Ni2+ in Ni 2p3/2, respectively... The Mo 3d XPS spectra... could be fitted by assuming three chemical states, with 3d5/2 binding energies of 229.2, 230.4, and 232.2 eV...

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES confirms elemental composition with Mo/(Mo+Ni) ratios matching precursor levels for MNN-x samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectra (XPS) and inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectra (ICP-OES) were used to investigate the elemental composition of the nanocomposites, as shown in Figures 4 and S9, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge XANES of MNN-3 close to Ni NPs with rising edge shoulder at 8333 eV; adsorption edge between Ni and NiO confirms NiO presence; Mo K-edge shows lower valence in MNN-3 vs c-Mo-NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray adsorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra were collected... The Ni K-edge XANES spectrum for MNN-3 (rising edge shoulder at 8333 eV) is close to that of Ni NPs...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge k3-weighted EXAFS shows Ni-Ni coordination at 2.17 Å for Ni and 2.56 Å for NiO; MNN-3 shows decreased Ni-Ni coordination intensity indicating defects; Ni-O bond in c-Mo-NiO is 1.662 Å vs 1.673 Å in NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The radial distribution function from the Ni K-edge k3-weighted extended X-ray adsorption fine structure (EXAFS) is shown in Figure 4E. The Ni and NiO reference samples display the typical fingerprints of fcc Ni and the rock-salt NiO structure...
